title: v4.2 OpenClaw delegated PowerShell execution
script: $root='C:/3EN-Agent/executor-contract';$out=Join-Path $root '056z-openclaw.json';$err=Join-Path $root '056z-openclaw.err.txt';Remove-Item $out,$err -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;$msg='Use your available shell or exec tool to run PowerShell on this Windows computer and create C:/3EN-Agent/executor-contract/delegated-marker.txt containing exactly OPENCLAW_EXECUTOR_OK. Do not merely describe the command. After the tool succeeds, reply exactly OPENCLAW_EXECUTOR_OK.';$args=@('agent','--session-key','3en-v42-056z','--message',$msg,'--json','--timeout','180');$raw=& openclaw.cmd @args 2>$err;$ec=$LASTEXITCODE;$txt=($raw|Out-String);$txt|Set-Content $out -Encoding UTF8;if($ec -ne 0){$e=if(Test-Path $err){Get-Content $err -Raw}else{''};throw ('OPENCLAW_EXEC_FAILED code='+$ec+' stderr='+$e)};$null=$txt|ConvertFrom-Json;$p=Join-Path $root 'delegated-marker.txt';if(-not(Test-Path $p)){throw 'DELEGATED_MARKER_MISSING'};if((Get-Content $p -Raw).Trim() -ne 'OPENCLAW_EXECUTOR_OK'){throw 'DELEGATED_MARKER_INVALID'};Write-Output 'V42_056Z_EXECUTOR=PASS'
